name: Adriel
bio: Adriel was the son of Barzillai of Meholah. Saul had promised his older daughter Merab to David, but when the time came, he gave her to Adriel instead (1 Samuel 18:19). Scripture later records that when David handed over seven of Saul's descendants to the Gibeonites to settle Saul's bloodguilt, among them were "the five sons of Michal daughter of Saul, whom she had borne to Adriel" (2 Samuel 21:8-9) — some translations, including the KJV, render this as the sons "she brought up for Adriel," which is traditionally understood to mean these five were actually born to Merab and raised by her sister Michal, since Michal herself is elsewhere said to have had no children of her own (2 Samuel 6:23).
